snippet.title: Lineage II Chronicle 3: Rise of Darkness - CGI Movie (E3 2004)
snippet.description:
In order to prevent Shilen from waking up, Kain raises his sword toward Elcardia, whom he once loved.
At that moment, Shiken appears and blocks his strike. The first seal begins to break at last!

Video shown at E3 in 2004.
